findings.message: The function grapheme_str_split() is not present in PHP version 8.3 or earlier (this package ships its own grapheme_str_split(), so the call works on every PHP version)

INI directive 'mbstring.func_overload' is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): Function utf8_encode() is deprecated since PHP 8.2; Use mb_convert_encoding(), UConverter::transcode() or iconv instead
